## Intro
This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to create and play haptic feedback on a Teslasuit device. The page is structured to help developers understand the process of initializing the Teslasuit API, connecting to a device, accessing the Haptic subsystem, and playing haptic touches.

## Code for Haptic Touch
````python
import time
import _setup_sys_path

from teslasuit_sdk import ts_api
import teslasuit_sdk.subsystems.ts_haptic
from teslasuit_sdk.ts_mapper import TsBone2dIndex

# Touch parameters — adjust these to change the haptic sensation
TOUCH_FREQ_HZ     = 100                           # stimulation frequency in Hz (valid range: 1–150)
TOUCH_PERIOD_US   = 1000000 // TOUCH_FREQ_HZ    # period in µs; formula: 1000000 / frequency_hz
TOUCH_AMPLITUDE   = 40    # signal amplitude as a percentage (valid range: 1–100)
TOUCH_PULSE_WIDTH = 150   # electrical pulse width in microseconds
TOUCH_DURATION_MS = 3000  # how long the touch plays, in milliseconds

def main():
    try:
        print("Initialize API")
        api = ts_api.TsApi()  # create the central API object

        # Wait until the suit is connected, then get a reference to it
        device = api.get_device_manager().get_or_wait_last_device_attached()
        player = device.haptic  # haptic subsystem for creating and playing touches
        mapper = api.mapper     # mapper translates body-area names into channel lists

        print("Setup channels to play and touch parameters")
        # Build the full layout of haptic electric channels for this device version
        layout   = mapper.get_haptic_electric_channel_layout(device.get_mapping())
        bones    = mapper.get_layout_bones(layout)
        # Select only the channels that cover the right upper arm
        channels = mapper.get_bone_contents(bones[TsBone2dIndex.RightUpperArm.value])
        params   = player.create_touch_parameters(
            period=TOUCH_PERIOD_US,
            amplitude=TOUCH_AMPLITUDE,
            pulse_width=TOUCH_PULSE_WIDTH,
        )

        print("Create touch and play")
        # create_touch returns a playable ID that can be scheduled with play_playable
        playable_id = player.create_touch(params, channels, TOUCH_DURATION_MS)
        player.play_playable(playable_id)

        print("Wait until playback finished...")
        time.sleep(TOUCH_DURATION_MS / 1000)  # convert ms → seconds
        print("Finished")

    except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit):
        print('\n! Received keyboard interrupt, quitting haptic touch play\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
````

## Expected output
```
Initialize API
Setup channels to play and touch parameters
Create touch and play
Wait until playback finished...
Finished
```
